control_description: Automated monitoring of core AuroraPay services (Debit and e-Transfer) with end-to-end synthetic transactions, latency/error thresholds, and on-call escalation for breaches.
comments: Alert coverage in place, but thresholds and runbook maturity vary between services.

control_name: Change management approvals for production deployments
control_description: Formal change management process requiring documented risk assessment, peer review, and approval before deploying code or configuration changes to production AuroraPay systems.
comments: Recent major incidents linked more to capacity than change failures; process considered stable.

control_name: Post-incident review with root cause analysis
control_description: Structured post-incident review (PIR) process for all high-severity incidents, requiring root cause analysis, documented actions, and tracking of remediation items to closure.
comments: PIRs completed but quality and follow-through on remediation actions are inconsistent.

control_name: Fraud rules engine and velocity checks
control_description: Configured fraud rules and velocity checks on AuroraPay e-Transfer transactions to detect unusual patterns (e.g., rapid high-value sends, new devices, high-risk destinations) and block or review suspicious payments.
comments: Rules maintained but tuning cadence is informal; some emerging scam patterns not yet fully covered.

control_description: Educational messaging and in-app prompts that inform customers about common scams (e.g., impersonation, urgent payment requests) and encourage verification before sending money.
comments: Content exists but is not consistently surfaced at high-risk moments (e.g., first-time high-value sends).

control_name: Privileged access management policy and role design
control_description: Defined privileged roles, least-privilege principles, and access provisioning standards for AuroraPay systems, including separate admin roles, limited standing access, and break-glass procedures.
comments: Roles and standards defined, but legacy accounts and ad hoc exceptions remain in some systems.

control_description: Formal quarterly review of all privileged access in scope for AuroraPay systems, requiring system owner attestation, challenge of exceptions, and documented removal of inappropriate or stale access.
comments: Q1 review delayed for two systems; challenge depth varies and some service accounts lack clear ownership.

control_name: Centralized security logging and high-severity alerts
control_description: Centralized collection of security logs from core AuroraPay components with correlation rules and high-severity alerts routed to the security operations function for triage and investigation.
comments: Core components integrated, but some auxiliary services and vendor logs are not yet fully onboarded.
